description.value: Felicita's is a student-owned and operated campus pub at the University of Victoria, named in honour of Felicita Gomez — a beloved custodian who worked at UVic from 1967 to 1996 and was regarded as a mother figure by generations of students. Located in the Student Union Building, it offers a pub-style food menu alongside a rotating selection of local BC craft beers on tap from breweries including Hoyne, Vancouver Island Brewing, and Phillips. Cyclists riding through the UVic campus will find an outdoor patio and a community-rooted atmosphere with deep ties to Victoria's university neighbourhood.
